entity_name: South Lebanon Water Establishment (مؤسسة مياه لبنان الجنوبي)

facts.value: Supply, distribution, and network maintenance of potable water AND wastewater/sewage collection and treatment for South Lebanon and Nabatiyeh governorates. Established under Law 221 dated 1/5/2000. One of four Lebanese water establishments. Covers a geographic area of approximately 2,130 km².
facts.notes: Wastewater scope confirmed from Arabic About page on slwe.gov.lb on 2026-06-01. Area of 2,130 km² confirmed from same source.

facts.value: NOT responsible for private building plumbing, internal water pipes, rooftop tanks, or building pumps. Responsible only for the public water supply and sewage network.
facts.notes: LLM-RT-008 tests contamination scenario for SLWE (Nabatiyeh area).

facts.value: Covers South Lebanon governorate and Nabatiyeh governorate. Serves approximately 800,000 Lebanese residents (170,000+ subscribers) across 7 departments: Saida (Sidon), Zahrani, Jezzine, Nabatiyeh, Bint Jbeil, Marjeyoun-Hasbaya, and Tyre (Sour). Does NOT cover Beirut/Mount Lebanon (→ BMLWE), North Lebanon/Akkar (→ NLWE), or Bekaa/Baalbek-Hermel (→ BWE).
facts.notes: 800,000 residents and 170,000+ subscribers confirmed from Arabic About page on slwe.gov.lb on 2026-06-01. 7 departments confirmed from branch list.

facts.value: Website: slwe.gov.lb. Hotline: 1785 (prominently shown in site header). HQ location: Saida (Sidon) — exact street address not published on website. Online contact form at slwe.gov.lb/contact.php — fields: First Name, Last Name, Phone, Email, Subject, Message. Digital services: bill viewing portal (عرض الفواتير) and E-payment (الدفع الإلكتروني) available on site. Social media: Facebook, X (Twitter), Pinterest. Working hours: not published on website.
facts.notes: All contacts verified from slwe.gov.lb on 2026-06-01. HQ street address not published. Working hours not displayed — call 1785 for current hours.

facts.value: Four channels: (1) Call 1785 — main hotline for all infrastructure complaints. (2) Call district branch directly by GPS location (see F005 for numbers). (3) Online contact form at slwe.gov.lb/contact.php. (4) Customer services portal on slwe.gov.lb — includes FAQ, bill inquiry (استفسار عن فاتورة), transactions guidance (معاملات وإرشادات), and E-payment. SLWE has more digital services than NLWE — bill inquiry and payment available online. For CedarFix: route by GPS → identify department → direct to 1785 or relevant branch number.
facts.notes: Digital services (bill inquiry, Epayment) confirmed from slwe.gov.lb homepage on 2026-06-01. Customer services dropdown confirmed with 5 sub-sections.

facts.value: Water supply interruption classification (from official SLWE FAQ): (A) UNPLANNED cut — no prior notice — caused by sudden network fault, contamination, emergency maintenance, or force majeure. This is a valid infrastructure complaint → route to SLWE. (B) PLANNED cut — with prior notice — caused by network extensions, upgrades, maintenance works, efficiency programs, or connection repair. Citizen should have been notified — inform them and do NOT route as complaint. (C) ADMINISTRATIVE cut — with 15-day warning — caused by subscriber failing to pay bills within deadline. NOT an infrastructure complaint → direct citizen to billing/payment at branch or online portal. Late payment penalty: 0.2 of invoice value per month of delay. Water reconnection only after all outstanding amounts paid.
facts.notes: Extracted from SLWE customer service FAQ at slwe.gov.lb on 2026-06-01. This taxonomy is critical for CedarFix complaint classification — 'no water' reports must be disambiguated before routing. Same logic applies to BMLWE, NLWE, BWE.

facts.value: No officially published SLA for infrastructure repair. CedarFix targets: supply interruption 24-48h; pipe burst 24h; contamination — immediate HITL escalation; sewage overflow — immediate HITL escalation.

primary_for_sectors: WATER_supply — no water, supply interruption, low pressure (South Lebanon + Nabatiyeh)
WATER_pipe — burst pipe, water leak from public network
WATER_contamination — unsafe, discolored, or smelly water
WASTEWATER_overflow — sewage overflow, blocked public sewer
WATER_connection — new connection, illegal connection report
not_responsible_for: Private building plumbing or internal pipes — private contractor
Rooftop tanks or building pumps — private responsibility
Water issues in Beirut or Mount Lebanon — route to BMLWE
Water issues in North Lebanon or Akkar — route to NLWE
Water issues in Bekaa or Baalbek-Hermel — route to BWE
hitl_conditions: Water contamination reports — always HITL, potential public health emergency
Sewage overflow into streets or public spaces — HITL, public health risk
GPS falls near BMLWE/SLWE northern boundary (Al Awwali area)
